Noah (People Ops): Hey team — follow-up Q&A from today's all-hands re: remote/hybrid logistics (travel, offsites, coworking/hubs, desk booking). Post short questions here and we'll answer live. I'll fold clarifications into the Workstyle playbook this week. Link: https://intranet.redwood/workstyle :wave:

Lina Gomez: Quick one — I'm booking flights from Madrid for the June offsite. Should I use the corporate portal or can I buy and expense later? Also, do we issue visa invitation letters?

Noah (People Ops): Use the corporate Travel Portal when possible for best fares and auto-generated itineraries (helps with visa support). If you already booked, submit digital receipts within 30 days and tag expense "offsite-travel". For visa invite letters, DM me the exact passport name + travel dates and I'll generate one. :airplane:

Ethan Chen: Are coworking days covered if I'm in NYC for a week sprint? What's the process for non-company hubs?

Noah (People Ops): We provide "hub credits" that cover up to 10 coworking days per month for remote employees traveling between regions. Use the expense code "hub-credit" and attach booking confirmation. For non-approved spaces, please run a short pre-approval via people-ops@redwood.com or a quick Slack ping with the location link.

Zara Ibrahim: Desk booking question — is it possible to keep the same desk 1 day/week for the quarter?

Noah (People Ops): We're piloting "anchor slots" — you can reserve one recurring slot per week for a quarter (requests via Office Booking -> Anchors). If you require a fixed desk for medical/ergonomic reasons, file an accommodation request and we'll handle it immediately.

Lina Gomez: Lodging: are short-term rentals (Airbnb/VRBO) allowed for team offsites? Any caps or rules?

Noah (People Ops): Short-term rentals are permitted for team offsites when they are the most cost-effective option. Follow these rules: 1) total nightly cost must not exceed the city tier cap (see policy), 2) list the host as "offsite-housing" on your expense, 3) get pre-approval for shared houses that host >8 employees. Personal guest expenses aren't reimbursed.

DevRelBot: Policy update: Offsite city-tier and per-night caps refreshed 2025-04-15. See: https://intranet.redwood/policies/offsite-caps (automated notice).

Ethan Chen: If my passport renewal delays travel, do we offer hybrid attendance support?

Noah (People Ops): Yes — if you can't travel due to documentation delays, we can: 1) provide a remote participation stipend (covers local coworking / desk rental); or 2) if schedule allows, shift your travel window +/- 21 days. Ping me ASAP so we can issue updated paperwork.

Zara Ibrahim: Parking for the Redwood LA hub — any advice?

Noah (People Ops): LA hub has limited on-site parking. Use the commuter app to reserve when necessary. We reimburse reasonable parking with tag "parking-hub". Consider rideshare or public transit where available.

Lina Gomez: Any exceptions for family joining (partner travel)?

Noah (People Ops): Generally no — partner travel is not reimbursed unless explicitly invited by the company for business reasons. If a partner must attend for a documented business requirement, coordinate with your manager and copy people-ops.

Noah (People Ops): Example item to paste into expense form if helpful:

```
Expense title: Madrid-June-Offsite-Flight
Amount: 742.20
Category: Travel - Flight
Receipts: flight_0425.pdf
Expense tag: offsite-june-2025
```

Noah (People Ops): Thanks for the quick Qs — I'll pin an updated FAQ in this channel and email the team summary. If you need individualized help (visa letters, special accommodations, extended travel windows), DM me or email people-ops@redwood.com :spiral_note_pad:
